narrative.intro: Spencer Construction obligated $2.4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Spencer Construction won 5 awards so far in the fiscal year, producing an average award size of $472M and driving a year-over-year change that is up 321227.1%. Spencer Construction recorded smaller obligations in earlier fiscal years: FY22 $15.3M, FY23 $72.9K, and FY25 $735K, while FY21 and FY24 had no recorded obligations. Spencer Construction's current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. Spencer Construction reached the current total with a small number of awards, which makes the FY2026 profile highly concentrated at the award level. Spencer Construction's figures here report obligations and award counts only, so readers should treat the FY2026 totals as year-to-date obligations rather than full-year results. Spencer Construction's large average award size reflects a small award count versus the total obligations recorded so far this fiscal year.
